title: Bind each mark to its place
statement: Bind each marked word in a quotation to its exact position, and refuse a mark named only by a word that recurs there rather than guess which one.
detail: The quotation-card frame module marks a span by its code-point offsets together with the exact text expected there, so either occurrence of a repeated word can be targeted, and editing the quotation without rebinding the mark fails validation (`g9-unit-video-packages/quote-card/README.md`). Its notes say the older pilot highlighted the first matching substring, and that a migration should reject ambiguous repeated words instead of guessing an occurrence. The lesson engine's own binder still takes the first whole-word match, ignoring case (`g9/transformer/src/video/frames.js`); no stored block marks a word that occurs twice in its quotation, so no wrong highlight has been seen.
against: The lesson engine's binder marks a repeated word at its first occurrence without a warning: "const m = re.exec(q);" (g9/transformer/src/video/frames.js line 42).
